data.description:
## Description

**What**: Add an optional `rule_id` field to the reviewer-findings.json schema documented in `plugins/dso/docs/workflows/prompts/reviewer-base.md`. The change must be non-breaking — pre-existing fixtures without `rule_id` must continue to validate.
**Why**: `rule_id` is the cross-tool join key downstream consumers (LAURA, replay-regression-harness) will use to compare reviewer behavior across tools.
**Scope**:
- IN: `reviewer-base.md` edit adding `rule_id` as an optional field with description and examples. Fixture-validation evidence confirming non-breaking change.
- OUT: Populating `rule_id` in actual reviewer agents (a separate calibration concern). Downstream consumer logic.

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, `grep -n 'rule_id' plugins/dso/docs/workflows/prompts/reviewer-base.md` returns lines documenting the new optional field with a description and example.
  ← Satisfies: sc-8  (sc-8: "reviewer-base.md schema includes optional rule_id field for findings, non-breaking")
- When this story is complete, all existing reviewer-findings.json fixtures in the repo validate against the updated schema without modification.
  ← Satisfies: sc-8
- When this story is complete, the schema explicitly marks `rule_id` as optional and documents its absence as semantically equivalent to no rule attribution.
  ← Satisfies: sc-8

## Considerations

- [Non-breaking] Existing reviewer agents must not be required to populate `rule_id`; the field is purely additive.
- [Naming] `rule_id` should be reserved for stable, semantically meaningful identifiers — document examples in the schema.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a reviewer-finding consumer, I want reviewer-base.md to document an optional rule_id field on findings (non-breaking), so that downstream telemetry and LAURA-style consumers can attribute findings to a stable rule identifier.
